stated_purpose: Simple utility flashlight application using the device LED flash.
policy_text:
TorchGlow Pro respects your digital privacy.

1. Location Information: We do not collect, track, or share your precise location or GPS data.
2. Audio and Microphone: We never record audio, wiretap, or access your device microphone under any circumstance.
3. Address Book: We do not read, access, or upload your contacts list.
4. Camera Usage: The camera hardware permission is requested solely to toggle the hardware LED torch on and off. No photos or video recordings are ever captured, stored, or transmitted.
5. Personal Data: No personal identifiers or phone numbers are gathered.
